Frontend: (a) REGRESSION verified — /checkout submit now lands on /checkout/success/{orderId} with bank transfer panel (was bouncing to /cart in iter3); (b) REGRESSION verified — mobile drawer 'Пазарувай' toggle expands/collapses submenu with the 6 collection links; (c) Desktop 1920: single-row header, logo LEFT, desktop-nav present, search+cart on right, NO hamburger, NO account/person link inside header (confirmed via DOM query); (d) hover 'Пазарувай' opens shop-dropdown with 6 category + 1 all-peptides + 'Виж всички' entry (7 dropdown-collection- testids); (e) hero .pp-hero--bleed bbox width=1920 (full-bleed) and bestsellers section computed backgroundColor = rgb(255,255,255) white; (f) BG homepage tiles all Cyrillic; (g) Mobile 430: no hamburger label needed but 'nav-drawer-trigger' + search on left, 8 mobile sliding nav items, no /account link in header; (h) /en/products/2-tesamorelin renders 'Tesamorelin 10mg', body has no BGN лв; (i) /fr/products/2-tesamorelin renders French chrome + English pivot title (falls back to en, not bg); (j) skip link (.pp-skip-link) + <main id='main-content'> both present; (k) No Radix 'Missing Description' console warnings after opening search-drawer or cart-drawer; (l) /admin/delisted-links full CRUD works via UI (add → mark rotated → delete row disappears); (m) /admin/locales renders 11 locale-route rows and en prefix is /en; (n) /admin/products list still renders (17 edit links). One frontend bug found: /admin/locales SAVE is broken — payload schema mismatch — after clicking save and reloading, home_path reverted to '/'.

ui_bugs.issue: The save button sends `api.put('/admin/settings', { locale_routes: routes })` but backend `SettingsIn` requires `{ value: {...} }`. The PUT is rejected with 422 so changes never persist (verified by editing route-home-en, saving, reloading — value reverts). Additionally, even if wrapped correctly, sending only `{ value: { locale_routes } }` would OVERWRITE the entire site settings object (announcements, discount_codes, resend_api_key, hero copy) — the save must merge locale_routes into the existing settings.

integration_issues.issue: Frontend/backend contract mismatch (locale_routes vs value:{}). Fix: `const cur = (await api.get('/admin/settings')).data.settings; await api.put('/admin/settings', { value: { ...cur, locale_routes: routes } });`

issues: Announcement text is stored as a single string list in site settings and rendered as-is; on /en, /fr, /gr etc. it still shows Bulgarian '✅ Потвърдено качество…'. Consider making announcements per-locale (or at minimum admin-visible warning) — not blocking but visible on every localised page.

action_items: Fix AdminLocalesPage.save() to (1) wrap payload in `{ value: {...} }` and (2) merge locale_routes into the current settings object so other keys (announcements, discount_codes, resend_api_key, etc.) are preserved.
Optional: localise announcement bar per locale, or at least document that BG announcement is intentional across locales.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1172 lines — still monolithic. Split into routers (auth, catalog, checkout, admin_*, seo).
AdminLocalesPage: save() sends `{ locale_routes }` instead of `{ value: {...settings, locale_routes} }` — silent 422 and would clobber all other settings if the schema were relaxed. Critical.
sitemap.xml grows as N_urls × N_locales entries with N_locales alternates each — O(N × 11²). For a full catalog this file will be large; consider a sitemap index and one file per locale.
Announcement bar text is not translated. Since /en, /fr etc. are supposed to be fully localised, hard-coded BG announcements leak Cyrillic on every non-BG page (visible from very first paint).
DelistedLinkIn permits arbitrary `status` strings — no enum validation; consider Literal['pending','rotated','redirected','ignored'].
AdminLocalesPage sends the entire routes map on save; if two admins edit concurrently, last write wins with no diff/merge.

rca_of_the_issue: AdminLocalesPage.jsx line 21: `await api.put('/admin/settings', { locale_routes: routes })`. Backend `SettingsIn` model (server.py:863) requires field `value: Dict[str, Any]`. FastAPI rejects the payload with 422 (unprocessable entity), the toast catches the error but the pattern `try { … toast.success } catch { toast.error }` shows only the caught error — user thinks save failed for other reasons. Fix in AdminLocalesPage.save(): fetch current settings, spread them, place locale_routes inside `value` and PUT the whole object. Reference implementation exists in AdminSettingsPage.jsx line 26 (`api.put('/admin/settings', { value: s })`).
